consequent.text: Naisargika (permanent) friendship: a fixed friend/neutral/enemy relation between planets by nature, identical in every chart.

quote:
A planet is a friend or an enemy of 
another planet in consequence of its nature. This 
naisargika relationship is not based on exchange 
of any mutual courtesies.

ambiguity_notes: Encoded in dignity.py; the book reproduces the Manual of Hindu Astrology table (Art. 30).

consequent.text: The permanent-friendship table: e.g. the Sun's friends are Moon, Mars, Jupiter; neutral Mercury; enemies Saturn, Venus. Full table per planet.

quote:
When we say that Venus (Sukra) is an 
enemy (satru) of Sun (Ravi) we mean that there 
is mutual counteraction between the rays of the 
' two planets.

ambiguity_notes: Shadbala totals from app/core/shadbala.py drive this comparison.

consequent.text: Application: the first Dasa goes to the strongest of Lagna, Sun and Moon; in a period/sub-period the stronger lord's results predominate.

quote:
in deciding Dasantardasa (periods and sub-periods) 
the first Dasa (period)is attributed to the most 
powerful of the Lagna (the Ascendant), the Sun 
and the Moon.

consequent.text: The Parasari Shadbala — six sources of planetary strength: Sthana (positional), Dik (directional), Kala (temporal), Chesta (motional), Naisargika (permanent), Drik (aspectual).

quote:
The Parasari system re- 
cognises Shad or six kinds of potency. They 
are :—(1) Sthanabala or Positional strength, (2) 
Dikbala or Directional strength, (3) Kalabala or. < 
"Temporal strength, (4) Chestabala or Motional 
strength, (5) Naisargikabala or Permanent strength 
and (6) Drikbala or Aspect strength.

consequent.text: Two friendships: Naisargika (permanent, by nature) and Tatkalika (temporary, by relative house position), compounded into the five-fold compound relation.

quote:
There are two types or relations bet- 
ween planets. They are Naisargika and Tatkalika.
